description.fun: Celesteela is a giant bamboo-and-rocket Ultra Beast from the Ultra Crater that grows out of the ground like a plant, then blasts off into space for reasons nobody knows. It fires flammable gas from its arms to fly, with enough thrust to flatten a whole bamboo forest. It seems inspired by the tale of Princess Kaguya, a girl found inside a bamboo stalk who turned out to come from the Moon.
description.guide: Celesteela is a Steel- and Flying-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-04 Blaster, that looks like bamboo crossed with a space rocket. It propels itself with flammable gas, powerfully enough to fly into space. It is tied with Cosmoem as the heaviest Pokémon, and is a counterpart to Kartana.
description.tagline: A bamboo rocket from another world that grows, then blasts off
